summary: Generates TOP image data from Python callbacks, commonly by copying compatible NumPy arrays into the output texture.

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT containing the Script TOP Python hooks.

key_params.name: setuppars
key_params.note: Run setupParameters() to create/update custom parameters.

key_params.name: modoutsidecook
key_params.note: Allow the operator to be modified outside its cook.

common_gotchas: The callback DAT is the execution contract; missing or stale callbacks mean no useful generated image.
The official id is setuppars, not setupparams.
copyNumpyArray expects compatible array channel layout, commonly 3 or 4 channels.
Outside-cook modification must be enabled when writing to the TOP outside the cook lifecycle.
key_concepts: Script TOP creates image data from Python rather than from a fixed built-in image operation.
The core output workflow is the callback DAT using copyNumpyArray with compatible 3- or 4-channel arrays.
Setup Parameters runs only when the setup pulse is triggered, so custom parameters should be deliberately regenerated.
Modifying the TOP outside its cook requires the official outside-cook modification toggle.
